lines.zh: 我从钟乳石下穿过，像另一根石笋。
lines.en: I pass beneath a stalactite, another dripstone shape.

lines.zh: 尖鼻子先出水，身子才跟上。
lines.en: My pointed snout breaks the water first, body following.

lines.zh: 我在石笋之间绕，找最窄的那条缝。
lines.en: I weave between stalagmites, seeking the narrowest gap.

lines.zh: 水滴打在背上，我不躲。
lines.en: Drips strike my back; I do not flinch.

lines.zh: 两条同伴跟着我，我们贴得很紧。
lines.en: Two companions trail me, keeping very close.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞底游，肚皮擦过碎石。
lines.en: I swim along the cave floor, belly scraping gravel.

lines.zh: 四十格以下的水，才合我的脾气。
lines.en: Water below forty blocks suits my temper.

lines.zh: 我游一段就停，装作石头。
lines.en: I swim a stretch, then stop and pass for stone.

lines.zh: 石面全是尖的，我却不碰一下。
lines.en: The stone is all points, yet I touch none of it.

lines.zh: 我向上斜游，绕过一根垂下的石柱。
lines.en: I angle upward around a hanging stone column.

lines.zh: 水声很密，我的动作比水声还轻。
lines.en: The dripping is dense; my motion is quieter still.

lines.zh: 五十五厘米的身子，在缝里刚好。
lines.en: Half a meter of body fits the crevice exactly.

lines.zh: 我回头看一眼同伴，它们还在。
lines.en: I glance back; my companions are still there.

lines.zh: 我沿着湿痕游，那是水指的路。
lines.en: I follow the wet trail the water left me.

lines.zh: 我贴着石壁的湿面往上游。
lines.en: I swim up along the wet face of the wall.

lines.zh: 尖鼻子探进石缝，找路。
lines.en: My sharp snout probes a crevice for a way.

lines.zh: 我在一根断掉的石柱边绕行。
lines.en: I circle around a broken stone pillar.

lines.zh: 水的凉意从鳃边流过去。
lines.en: Cool water runs past my gills.

lines.zh: 我悬在石笋尖上，像它长出来的一截。
lines.en: I hang on a stalagmite's tip, like a piece grown out of it.

lines.zh: 我张着嘴，等一滴水落进来。
lines.en: I hold my mouth open, waiting for a drop to fall in.

lines.zh: 洞里只有水声，我听了很久。
lines.en: Only water sounds in the cave; I listen a long while.

lines.zh: 我的鳞和石头的颜色很像。
lines.en: My scales are very close to the stone's color.

lines.zh: 同伴靠在我身侧，一动不动。
lines.en: A companion rests against my side, perfectly still.

lines.zh: 四点血的心跳，慢而稳。
lines.en: A four-point heart beats slow and steady.

lines.zh: 我把尖鼻子收回来，藏在石影里。
lines.en: I draw my pointed snout back into the stone's shadow.

lines.zh: 滴水的节奏变了，我抬起头。
lines.en: The dripping changes rhythm; I lift my head.

lines.zh: 我到底是石笋还是鱼，自己也不清楚。
lines.en: Whether I am dripstone or fish, I am not sure.

lines.zh: 水面平得像一块磨过的石。
lines.en: The water lies flat as polished stone.

lines.zh: 我等一条虫掉下来，等得发困。
lines.en: I wait for a worm to drop and grow sleepy.

lines.zh: 洞顶的水珠映着我，很小一个。
lines.en: A bead on the ceiling mirrors me, very small.

lines.zh: 我慢慢摆尾，只为不让水停住。
lines.en: I sway my tail slowly, only so the water will not still.

lines.zh: 这里没有天，我从不抬头。
lines.en: There is no sky here; I never look up.

lines.zh: 你手里有光，我往石缝里退。
lines.en: You carry light; I retreat into the crevice.

lines.zh: 我从石笋后面看你，只露尖鼻子。
lines.en: I watch from behind a stalagmite, only my snout showing.

lines.zh: 你踩碎了一块石笋，我听见了。
lines.en: You crushed a stalagmite; I heard it.

lines.zh: 你的影子在洞壁上很长，我盯着它。
lines.en: Your shadow stretches on the cave wall; I watch it.

lines.zh: 我们三条一起看你，方向都一样。
lines.en: All three of us look at you, the same way.

lines.zh: 你弯腰看水，我正好看见你的眼睛。
lines.en: You bend to the water; I see your eyes.

lines.zh: 我不怕光，只是不喜欢被照到。
lines.en: I do not fear light, only being lit.

lines.zh: 你手里的桶，我认得那个形状。
lines.en: That bucket in your hand — I know its shape.

lines.zh: 我把背脊竖起来，让自己像根石柱。
lines.en: I raise my spine to look like a stone column.

lines.zh: 你不动，我也不动，看谁先忍不住。
lines.en: You stay still; so do I. Who moves first?

lines.zh: 我的鳞裂了，露出灰白的肉。
lines.en: A scale splits, showing grey flesh.

lines.zh: 四点血，这一下拿走一半。
lines.en: Four points of health; that blow took half.

lines.zh: 我往石缝里钻，尖鼻子卡住了。
lines.en: I dive for the crevice and my snout jams.

lines.zh: 血液散在水里，同伴都退开。
lines.en: Blood spreads in the water; companions draw back.

lines.zh: 我摆尾太急，撞上了石笋。
lines.en: I beat my tail too hard and hit the stalagmite.

lines.zh: 疼一会儿就过去，我照样游。
lines.en: The ache will pass; I keep swimming anyway.

lines.zh: 这一下不算重，钩子更难受。
lines.en: This was not heavy; the hook was worse.

lines.zh: 石头上留下一小片湿痕。
lines.en: A small wet mark is left on the stone.

lines.zh: 我把身体压低，贴着洞底躲。
lines.en: I press my body low and hide along the floor.

lines.zh: 别追了，这洞里我比你熟。
lines.en: Stop chasing; I know this cave better than you.

lines.zh: 那点饵落在石头上，我看得见。
lines.en: That bait landed on the stone; I can see it.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，还是没张嘴。
lines.en: I circle twice and still do not open my mouth.

lines.zh: 香味浸进水里，慢慢散开。
lines.en: The scent seeps into the water and spreads slowly.

lines.zh: 同伴先咬了，我在旁边看。
lines.en: A companion bites first; I watch from the side.

lines.zh: 钩子挂在石缝上，晃啊晃的。
lines.en: The hook snags the crevice, swaying back and forth.

lines.zh: 我凑近闻，尖鼻子差点碰到钩。
lines.en: I lean in; my snout nearly touches the hook.

lines.zh: 这条虫不像虫，可我还是想吃。
lines.en: That worm is not a worm, yet I still want it.

lines.zh: 我张了嘴，又合上，第二次才咬。
lines.en: I open my mouth, close it, and bite on the second try.

lines.zh: 我上钩会游一点三速，甩不掉。
lines.en: Hooked, I swim at one point three and cannot shake it.

lines.zh: 这么小的饵，值得我离开石影。
lines.en: Bait this small is worth leaving my stone shadow.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我从石笋上滑开了。
lines.en: You bump me, and I slide off the stalagmite.

lines.zh: 我被推得转了个身，尖鼻子朝后。
lines.en: I am spun around, snout pointing backward.

lines.zh: 三条同伴被冲散，又慢慢聚回。
lines.en: Three companions scatter, then slowly regroup.

lines.zh: 石壁太硬，我撞得鳞都麻了。
lines.en: The wall is hard; the impact numbs my scales.

lines.zh: 你和我一样大，撞起来挺实在。
lines.en: You are about my size; the collision is solid.

lines.zh: 我贴着洞底让路，你还是踩到了水。
lines.en: I yield along the floor; you still step into the water.

lines.zh: 水花溅到石笋上，声音很脆。
lines.en: The splash hits the stalagmite with a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 我被挤到石缝里，动不了了。
lines.en: I am squeezed into the crevice and cannot move.

lines.zh: 我的身体只有半格宽，还是会撞上。
lines.en: Half a block wide, and still I collide.

lines.zh: 我摆尾稳住身子，慢慢游开。
lines.en: I steady myself with my tail and drift away.

lines.zh: 我们并排贴着石笋，尾鳍轻轻碰。
lines.en: We lie along the stalagmite, tail fins lightly touching.

lines.zh: 它背上的点比我的更细密。
lines.en: The spots along its back are finer than mine.

lines.zh: 石缝深处的水最静，我们去那里。
lines.en: The water deepest in the crevice is stillest; we go there.

lines.zh: 我用尖鼻子碰它的鳃盖，它没躲。
lines.en: I touch its gill cover with my snout; it does not flinch.

lines.zh: 两条鱼绕着一根石柱转了半圈。
lines.en: Two fish circle a stone pillar halfway around.

lines.zh: 这一群以后会变成四五条。
lines.en: This group will become four or five before long.

lines.zh: 我们的鳞映在石面上，像两块湿石头。
lines.en: Our scales on the stone look like two wet rocks.

lines.zh: 水声太大，我们靠得更近。
lines.en: The dripping is loud; we move closer.

lines.zh: 它先游开，又回头等我。
lines.en: It swims off first, then turns back to wait.

lines.zh: 洞里没有别处可去，只有彼此。
lines.en: There is nowhere else in this cave but each other.

lines.zh: 我叼起一块小石，觉得像虫。
lines.en: I pick up a pebble, mistaking it for a worm.

lines.zh: 你放下桶，我在桶边转了一圈。
lines.en: You set the bucket down; I circle its rim once.

lines.zh: 被装进桶里，我撞了好几次壁。
lines.en: In the bucket, I knock against the wall several times.

lines.zh: 水底那条虫，我一秒就叼走了。
lines.en: The worm on the floor is mine in a second.

lines.zh: 桶里的水没有滴水声，我不习惯。
lines.en: No dripping in the bucket's water; I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片脱落的鳞，又丢了。
lines.en: I pick up a shed scale and drop it again.

lines.zh: 什么掉进水里，我都先咬一口。
lines.en: Whatever falls in the water, I bite it first.

lines.zh: 被带走时，我还在找石缝。
lines.en: As I am carried off, I am still looking for a crevice.

lines.zh: 这么小的东西，也要费我一次低头。
lines.en: Something this small costs me one dip of the head.

lines.zh: 我叼着它游回石笋下，才慢慢吃。
lines.en: I carry it under the stalagmite before eating.

lines.zh: 水里有东西在动，我立刻停住。
lines.en: Something moves in the water; I stop at once.

lines.zh: 那条抢食的同伴，我盯上了。
lines.en: That companion stealing food — I have marked it.

lines.zh: 尖鼻子对准了，就是我的回答。
lines.en: My snout points at it; that is my answer.

lines.zh: 我看准了水面那只落水的虫。
lines.en: I fix on the insect that fell onto the water.

lines.zh: 目标不大，但动得很快。
lines.en: The target is small but moves fast.

lines.zh: 我把身子压低，贴着石底靠近。
lines.en: I lower my body and creep along the floor.

lines.zh: 一条同伴先动，其余的都跟着转向。
lines.en: One companion moves first; the rest all turn with it.

lines.zh: 钩子上的饵，也算一个目标。
lines.en: The bait on the hook counts as a target too.

lines.zh: 那道游法我认得，是受了伤的鱼。
lines.en: I know that motion: a fish already wounded.

lines.zh: 我看定这一条，别的都不算数。
lines.en: This one is decided; the rest do not count.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，石笋挡住了半圈。
lines.en: I circle it; a stalagmite blocks half the loop.

lines.zh: 它往石缝里钻，我在外面等。
lines.en: It dives into the crevice; I wait outside.

lines.zh: 我不冲，先看它怎么游。
lines.en: I do not charge; first I watch how it swims.

lines.zh: 水滴落下的间隙，正好够我靠近。
lines.en: The gap between drips is just enough to approach.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在石壁上，它看见了。
lines.en: My shadow falls on the wall; it has seen me.

lines.zh: 我把圈子缩到只剩一格。
lines.en: I shrink the circle to a single block.

lines.zh: 它停住，我也停住，水都不动。
lines.en: It stops, I stop; even the water holds still.

lines.zh: 尖鼻子对准它的侧腹，我在等。
lines.en: My snout aims at its flank; I am waiting.

lines.zh: 洞里回声太多，我只能靠看。
lines.en: Too many echoes in this cave; I rely on sight.

lines.zh: 四点血不算多，一击要够准。
lines.en: Four points of health is not much; one strike must be true.

lines.zh: 尖鼻子撞上去，它翻了个身。
lines.en: My snout strikes; it flips over.

lines.zh: 我死死咬住，甩头把它拖下来。
lines.en: I clamp down hard and whip my head to drag it off.

lines.zh: 这一口很窄，但扎得很进。
lines.en: The bite is narrow, but it goes deep.

lines.zh: 石洞里打起来，水声全乱了。
lines.en: Fighting in the stone cave, the water sounds all wrong.

lines.zh: 它比我大，我还是撞了过去。
lines.en: It is bigger than me; still I ram it.

lines.zh: 我打一下就走，不缠斗。
lines.en: I strike once and leave; I do not wrestle.

lines.zh: 我的牙小，胜在位置准。
lines.en: My teeth are small; my advantage is placement.

lines.zh: 水花打在石笋上，滴得更快了。
lines.en: Splash hits the stalagmite; the drips come faster.

lines.zh: 这一下没能咬穿，我退开再试。
lines.en: The bite fails to pierce; I back off to try again.

lines.zh: 洞里的仗都短，打完各自散开。
lines.en: Fights in the cave are short; afterward we scatter.

lines.zh: 溶洞里滴水，我就在水声里出现。
lines.en: The cave drips, and I appear within that sound.

lines.zh: 石笋的阴影里，多了三条鱼。
lines.en: In the stalagmite's shadow, three fish now exist.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里游出来，像石头活了。
lines.en: I slip from the crevice like stone coming alive.

lines.zh: 四十格深的地下，水是凉的。
lines.en: Forty blocks down, the water runs cool.

lines.zh: 我一出现，同伴就在旁边。
lines.en: The moment I appear, companions are beside me.

lines.zh: 水面照出洞顶，全是尖的。
lines.en: The surface mirrors a ceiling of points.

lines.zh: 四点血，够我在这洞里活着。
lines.en: Four points of health is enough to live in this cave.

lines.zh: 我的鳞刚长好，就学会了藏。
lines.en: My scales barely formed before I learned to hide.

lines.zh: 这一群只有两三条，正好。
lines.en: Two or three in this group is just right.

lines.zh: 洞里很静，我的第一摆尾很响。
lines.en: The cave is quiet; my first tailbeat is loud.

lines.zh: 火一过，我成了熟鱼，还带点石味。
lines.en: One pass of fire, and I am cooked fish with a stony tang.

lines.zh: 我从石台上摔下来，砸出一小片水花。
lines.en: I fall off the ledge and splash a small circle.

lines.zh: 水太浅了，我反倒喘不上气。
lines.en: The water is too shallow; I cannot breathe after all.

lines.zh: 一声爆响，洞顶掉下好几根石笋。
lines.en: A blast; several stalactites drop from the ceiling.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，石屑溅进水里。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back; stone chips splash into the water.

lines.zh: 咒力压下来，我的鳞全贴住了。
lines.en: Magic presses down; all my scales flatten.

lines.zh: 洞里没有虫，我瘦得露出石色。
lines.en: No worms in this cave; I grow thin enough to look like stone.

lines.zh: 雷顺着水进来，整条洞都亮了。
lines.en: Lightning comes down through the water; the whole cave lights up.

lines.zh: 水被抽走了，我的鳃贴在石头上。
lines.en: The water is drawn away; my gills press against stone.
